coordinate_space_note: Coordinates are in DISPLAY space (the page as a reader sees it: 792x612 landscape, top-left origin). The underlying PDF page is 612x792 with /Rotate 90, so a renderer that ignores /Rotate (e.g. pdf-lib) must map display (X,Y) -> raw PDF top-left (x,y) = (Y, 792-X) and draw the text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
table_note: Every table on this form is a repeating table. Column x-ranges and the first row's y are given per field, and the row height is a constant 14.3 pt for ALL of them. To add or generate rows programmatically, take the row-1 field and add 14.3*(n-1) to its y. Row counts are fixed by the pre-printed grid: PSI table = 3 rows (first row baseline y=288.8, columns Staff Name 18.2-198.2, Provider 198.2-436.7, Course Title 436.7-711.2, Issue Date 711.2-774.2); Lifeguard Certification table = 11 rows (first row baseline y=430.8, columns Staff Name+DOB 18.2-225.2, Lifeguarding Provider/Course Title+Issue Date 225.2-495.2, CPR Provider/Course Title+Issue Date 495.2-774.2); Additional First Aid and CPR Staff table (page 2) = 7 rows (first row baseline y=128.7, columns Staff Name+DOB 18.2-225.2, First Aid 225.2-499.7, CPR 499.7-774.2). Overflow staff must go on an attached sheet.
